about_the_game:
Dachs Hunter is a top-down roguelite game where you play as a dachshund wizard and must survive hordes of elemental monsters. Strategize as you discover and collect unique spells while mastering all elements.

Features:

  • Manual casting spells by default with a option to turn automatic

  • Casual 20 minutes runs plus boss fights

  • Collectable and upgradeable spells

  • Bosses with unique mechanics

Some of the content available in the demo version:

  • 2 maps

  • 4 bosses

  • 20 spells

  • 2 playable characters

  • 30+ monsters

  • and more..

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS or Linux distribution released after 2016
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8200, AMD Athlon XE BE-2300, Raspberry Pi 4
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5500 (Broadwell), AMD Radeon R5 Graphics (Kaveri), NVIDIA GeForce GT 730
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: SteamOS or Linux distribution released after 2020
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K, AMD Ryzen 5 1600, Raspberry Pi 5 with overclocking
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 (Pascal), AMD Radeon RX 460 (GCN 4.0)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
